method: Momentum / technical setups in the leading sectors. Target buy = level to accumulate (support or breakout retest); target sell = realistic resistance/measured target; conviction 1-5. Technical read, not advice - confirm live before acting.

Second leg of the energy trade with a 39-yr dividend-growth base. Accumulate pullbacks to ~$186 support; target $208. Invalid on a close below ~$174.
